approved_translation: Courage and courtesy in the face of danger win respect; treat all beings with dignity.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time a king had three sons. The first was called Prince of the Stars. The eldest brother was made king and he had his brothers rule with him. He also built a home for the water-sprite in the palace grounds.
interpretation_boundaries: Do not depict specific historical Buddha figures — keep characters as generic animals or people
